description.en: Three fixed dot-matrix shapes reveal flowing blue-green particles, hollow white contours and warm orange-pink textures.
description.zh: 三个固定点阵轮廓，分别呈现蓝绿粒子流、黑白空心圆弧与橙红纹理。

keywords: 粒子 纹理 点阵 三联 流动 空心 圆弧 蓝绿 橙红 Sarvam Anushka particle texture trio noise flow field

discovery.caveat: 本地点阵视觉重建；非原作者生成工具，不包含真实 AI 接口。

source.implementation: Independent Canvas2D renderer with compact Chebyshev motion fields fitted to tracked particle paths, seeded color/size noise, analytic colored silhouettes and measured monochrome contours. Reuses the existing LeiBox lifecycle. No reference video or raster texture is played at runtime; this is a reconstruction, not the author's generator or Sarvam source code.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Click any shape to pause or resume. Arrow keys step through frames; Home or Escape restarts the animation.
instructions.zh: 点击任一图形暂停或继续，左右方向键逐帧查看，Home 或 Escape 重新播放。
